headline: BEST EVER: GR Silver Drills 45m at 1,623 g/t Ag at San Marcial — Stock Jumps Nearly 50% on Blow-Out Results
snippet: GR Silver Mining (TSXV: GRSL) released hole SMS26-04 from San Marcial, Mexico, returning 45.1 metres at 1,623 g/t Ag including 8.25 metres at 8,579 g/t Ag — the best results in the deposit's history. Shares surged nearly 50% on the announcement, confirming the southeastern area's high-grade potential at depth within the 20,000-metre step-out campaign. Published ~May 19, 2026.

headline: COLLECTIVE MINING HITS OXIDE GOLD CORRIDOR — 71m at 1.95 g/t AuEq From Surface, 700m Strike Length at Northern Apollo
snippet: Collective Mining (TSX: CNL) discovered a precious metal-rich oxide zone at its Northern Apollo target in Colombia — a 700m by 200m corridor returning 71.2m at 1.95 g/t AuEq (0.75 g/t Au, 87 g/t Ag) from surface. Executive Chairman Ari Sussman called it a significant find with open-pit optionality; 14 rigs are expected to be turning before end of Q2 2026. Published May 20, 2026.

headline: TROILUS DRILLS OUTSIDE THE RESOURCE PIT — 2.92 g/t AuEq Over 19m at West Rim Zone Within 200m of Feasibility Reserve
snippet: Troilus Mining (TSX: TLG) expanded its West Rim Zone at the Quebec copper-gold project with 2.92 g/t AuEq over 19 metres sitting outside the current mineral resource and within 200 metres of the North Reserve Pit. The intercept is the strongest near-pit result drilled to date at Troilus and the zone remains open to the north — a potential resource addition adjacent to existing infrastructure. Published May 19, 2026.

headline: AUSTRALIA GREENLIGHTS $1.6B NOLANS RARE EARTH MINE — Five Nations' Export Credit Agencies Back Non-China NdPr Push
snippet: Arafura Rare Earths reached final investment decision on its $1.6 billion Nolans project in Australia's Northern Territory, backed by export credit agencies from the US, Canada, Germany and South Korea plus Gina Rinehart's Hancock Prospecting (15.5% stake). The mine will produce 4,440 tonnes of NdPr oxide per year targeting non-China markets; construction begins September 2026, first production targeted mid-2029. Published May 21, 2026.

headline: EQUINOX SWALLOWS ORLA IN $18.5B ALL-STOCK DEAL — New North American Gold Giant to Produce 1.1M oz in 2026
snippet: Equinox Gold (TSX: EQX) and Orla Mining (TSX: OLA) agreed on May 13 to combine in an all-share deal creating a North American producer with an implied equity value of US$18.5 billion — Canada's second-largest gold miner. Equinox shareholders retain 67%; Orla shareholders receive one Equinox share per Orla share. Shareholder votes scheduled for July, with closing expected Q3 2026.

headline: CHILE LIFTS COPPER CALL TO $5.55/LB — Cochilco Q1 Report Says AI Data Centres and EVs Will Keep Metal Elevated Into 2027
snippet: Chile's state copper commission Cochilco raised its 2026 average copper price forecast to $5.55/lb and sees 2027 at $5.10/lb, citing firm demand from energy transition, EVs and AI data infrastructure alongside persistent mine supply constraints. Copper futures were at ~$6.28/lb last week after pulling back from a record $6.65 hit on May 13. Published May 19, 2026.

headline: RARE EARTH PRICES STALL, STRUCTURAL DEFICIT DEEPENS — REEx Flags June MIIT Quota Announcement as Season's Pivotal Signal
snippet: REEx's structural signal tracker for the week of May 18–23 notes NdPr oxide fell 21% in April to $99.61/kg but remains 88% above its January open — a mid-cycle cooling, not a reversal. Analysts flag China's MIIT mid-year mining quota announcement (typically June) as the key catalyst: tighter quotas would validate Western producers' cost advantages in H2 2026. Published ~May 23, 2026.

headline: COT REPORT: GOLD SPECULATIVE LONGS HOLD STEADY AT $4,500 — Weekly Positioning Data Still Constructive After May Selloff
snippet: The May 22 Commitments of Traders report shows speculative long positioning in gold and silver held constructively despite gold's retreat from Q1 highs near $5,600 to current levels around $4,500. The weekly COT breakdown is a key positioning gauge widely tracked by junior mining investors as a leading indicator for near-term precious metals direction. Published May 22, 2026.

headline: CHINA ABSORBED 790+ TONNES of Silver in Early 2026 — Solar Boom Driving Import Surge the Spot Market Has Not Yet Priced In
snippet: China imported over 790 tonnes of silver in early 2026, largely driven by silver-paste demand for photovoltaic cell manufacturing. GoldSeek's weekly Gold SWOT analysis argues the physical demand signal is stronger than recent spot price weakness (pullback from $88 to ~$74) implies, with the structural supply deficit now heading into its sixth consecutive year. Published May 2026.

headline: SILVER'S SIXTH DEFICIT YEAR — But STOP CHASING at $76: Why the Structural Case May Already Be Priced In
snippet: GoldSilver.com's May 2026 silver outlook argues the structural deficit case is real — global silver demand is forecast to outstrip supply for the sixth straight year with physical investment up 20% — but warns retail investors against chasing the metal following a violent spike to $88 and swift reversal. The piece outlines the conditions under which the next sustainable leg higher will materialize. Published May 2026.
